triplets.head: Air Jordan I
triplets.tail: October/November 1984, NBA preseason and regular season games

triplets.head: Air Jordan III
triplets.tail: November 1987, regular season games (sporadic appearances in White Cement colorway); famous public debut at 1988 NBA All-Star Weekend, February 6-7, 1988, Chicago Stadium

triplets.head: Air Jordan IV
triplets.tail: 1989 NBA All-Star Game, February 12, 1989, Houston Astrodome

triplets.head: Air Jordan V
triplets.tail: 1990 NBA All-Star Game, February 11, 1990, Miami Arena

triplets.head: Air Jordan VI
triplets.tail: 1990-91 NBA regular season; earliest well-documented appearance at 1991 NBA All-Star Game, February 10, 1991, Charlotte Coliseum

triplets.head: Air Jordan VII
triplets.tail: 1991-92 NBA regular season; famous appearances at 1992 NBA All-Star Game and 1992 Barcelona Olympics

triplets.head: Air Jordan VIII
triplets.tail: 1993 NBA All-Star Game, February 21, 1993, Delta Center, Salt Lake City

triplets.head: Air Jordan IX
triplets.tail: Never worn on an NBA court (Michael Jordan retired October 6, 1993)

triplets.head: Air Jordan X
triplets.tail: March 19, 1995, Chicago Bulls vs. Indiana Pacers, Market Square Arena, Indianapolis (Michael Jordan's comeback game)

triplets.head: Air Jordan XI
triplets.tail: May 7, 1995, Game 1, 1995 Eastern Conference Semifinals, Chicago Bulls vs. Orlando Magic, Orlando Arena

triplets.head: Air Jordan XII
triplets.tail: November 6, 1996, Chicago Bulls vs. Miami Heat (earliest documented appearance; Michael Jordan scored 50 points)

triplets.head: Air Jordan XIII
triplets.tail: 1997-98 NBA regular season (exact first game date not publicly documented; shoe hit retail November 1997)

triplets.head: Air Jordan XIV
triplets.tail: June 7, 1998, Game 3, 1998 NBA Finals, Utah Jazz vs. Chicago Bulls, United Center, Chicago

triplets.head: Air Jordan XV
triplets.tail: Never worn on an NBA court (Michael Jordan retired January 13, 1999)

triplets.head: Air Jordan XVI
triplets.tail: September 1, 2001, NBA preseason, Washington Wizards vs. Detroit Pistons

triplets.head: Air Jordan XVII
triplets.tail: October 30, 2001, 2001-02 NBA season opener, Washington Wizards vs. New York Knicks

triplets.head: Air Jordan XVIII
triplets.tail: Approximately December 3, 2002, Washington Wizards vs. Milwaukee Bucks; also worn at 2003 NBA All-Star Game, February 9, 2003, Philips Arena, Atlanta

triplets.head: Air Jordan XIX
triplets.tail: February 13, 2004, 2004 Rookie Challenge (Rising Stars), Staples Center, Los Angeles, during NBA All-Star Weekend

triplets.head: Air Jordan XX
triplets.tail: 2005 NBA All-Star Game, February 20, 2005, Pepsi Center, Denver

triplets.head: Air Jordan XXI
triplets.tail: February 18-19, 2006, NBA All-Star Weekend 2006, Toyota Center, Houston (no specific single debut player documented)

triplets.head: Air Jordan XXII
triplets.tail: 2007 NBA All-Star Game, February 18, 2007, Thomas & Mack Center, Las Vegas

triplets.head: Air Jordan XXIII
triplets.tail: 2008 NBA All-Star Game, February 17, 2008, New Orleans Arena, New Orleans

triplets.head: Air Jordan 2010 (XXV)
triplets.tail: 2010 NBA All-Star Game, February 14, 2010, American Airlines Center, Dallas

triplets.head: Air Jordan 2011 (XXVI)
triplets.tail: December 25, 2010, Christmas Day game, Miami Heat vs. Los Angeles Lakers

triplets.head: Air Jordan 2012 (XXVII)
triplets.tail: Early 2012, exact first game not documented; worn by multiple Jordan Brand athletes from February 2012 onward

triplets.head: Air Jordan XX8
triplets.tail: December 4, 2012, OKC Thunder vs. Brooklyn Nets, Barclays Center, Brooklyn

triplets.head: Air Jordan XXIX
triplets.tail: April 19, 2014, Game 1, 2014 NBA Playoffs, OKC Thunder vs. Memphis Grizzlies

triplets.head: Air Jordan XXX
triplets.tail: January 15, 2016, OKC Thunder vs. Minnesota Timberwolves

triplets.head: Air Jordan XXXV
triplets.tail: August–September 2020, NBA Bubble in Orlando, before official unveiling

triplets.head: Air Jordan XXXVI
triplets.tail: May 25, 2021, Game 2, 2021 NBA Playoffs (First Round), Boston Celtics vs. Brooklyn Nets

triplets.head: Air Jordan XXXVIII
triplets.tail: March 25, 2023, NCAA March Madness Sweet 16, UCLA vs. South Carolina

triplets.head: Air Jordan XXXIX
triplets.tail: April 20, 2024, Game 1, 2024 NBA Playoffs (First Round), Orlando Magic vs. Cleveland Cavaliers

triplets.head: Air Jordan XL
triplets.tail: June 27, 2025, WNBA regular season, Minnesota Lynx vs. Atlanta Dream (first professional game debut)
